stem:
Priya is sorting objects in her kitchen cupboard for a school science project. She makes four groups:

Group 1 – a steel tumbler and an iron tava
Group 2 – a plastic spoon and a plastic bowl
Group 3 – a cotton towel and a woollen shawl
Group 4 – a glass tumbler and a steel spoon

In which group has she classified the objects using the common property 'the material they are made from'?

teacher.key_rationale: Group 1 (steel and iron are both metals) and Group 2 (both plastic) are classified by the same material. Group 3 mixes cotton and wool (different materials), and Group 4 mixes glass and steel, so they do not share a common material.
